CookiesConsentModal.title: Your well-being is our priority
CookiesConsentModal.text: At Bodhiwell we use cookies to make your experience when booking appointments simple, secure and personalized. These tools help us ensure everything works correctly and, with your consent, also to offer recommendations that better suit your needs. You can accept, reject or adjust your preferences whenever you want, always with the peace of mind that your access to our services is guaranteed.

CookiesPolicyPage.title: Cookies Policy
CookiesPolicyPage.subtitle: At Bodhiwell we use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the proper functioning of the platform, improve your user experience and analyze the use of the service.

intro.title: What are cookies?
intro.text1: Cookies are small files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet or phone) when you visit our site. They allow remembering certain actions or preferences, facilitating navigation and contributing to the technical functioning of the platform.
intro.text2: We may also employ similar technologies such as local storage, pixels or beacons, for comparable purposes.

purpose.title: Why do we use cookies?
purpose.intro: At Bodhiwell we use cookies to:

necessary.title: a) Strictly necessary
necessary.text: They allow the platform to function: secure access, login, internal navigation, forms, reservations and essential functionalities. They cannot be disabled.

performance.title: b) Performance or analytics
performance.text: They help us understand how the platform is used (most visited pages, usage times, etc.). They usually come from services like Google Analytics.

functionality.title: c) Functionality
functionality.text: They allow remembering your settings—such as language, profile preferences or configurations—to provide you with a smoother experience.

marketing.title: d) Personalization and marketing
marketing.text: They are used to show relevant content, measure the effectiveness of our communications or allow integrations with social networks.

thirdParty.title: Third-party cookies
thirdParty.intro: Some functionalities depend on external services that may install their own cookies, such as:
items: Google Analytics or other analytics tools.
Meta (Facebook/Instagram) for advertising campaigns.
Video platforms or external forms.
Chat, support or authentication tools.
thirdParty.note: These third parties manage their cookies according to their own policies.

management.title: How can you manage cookies?
management.intro: You can configure or disable cookies from:
items: Management banner: Appears on your first visit or when clearing cookies.
Browser settings: Most allow blocking, deleting or viewing installed cookies.

warning.title: Warning
warning.text: If you disable essential cookies, parts of the platform (reservations, account access, history) may not work correctly.

data.title: Collected data
items: Technical identifiers (session ID, device, browser).
Visited pages, times, clicks and navigation patterns.
Configuration preferences.
Access data necessary to keep the session active.
data.note: We never use cookies to access personal information from your device.

retention.title: Retention period
items: Session: They are deleted when closing the browser.
Persistent: They remain for a reasonable limited period to allow future recognitions.

updates.title: Updates to this policy
updates.text: Bodhiwell may update this Cookies Policy to reflect legal changes or service improvements. Any modification will be published on this page and will take effect at the time of its update.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about the use of cookies or want to exercise your rights, you can write to us at:

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.subtitle: Your trust is fundamental to us. Learn how we protect and manage your information.

commitment.title: Commitment to your privacy
commitment.text: On our platform, the privacy and security of your data is an absolute priority. We work under strict principles of confidentiality, transparency, and respect, aligned with the Law 18.331 on Personal Data Protection (Uruguay) and best international practices in digital health.

dataCollection.title: Data we collect
dataCollection.intro: When you register or use our services, we may request:
items: Personal data: Full name, email, age, phone number.
Health data: Information provided by you or generated during your medical consultations.
Usage data: Preferences, access logs, and activity within the platform to improve your experience.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.intro: We use your information exclusively to:
items: Create and manage your personal account securely.
Facilitate agile connection with health professionals.
Generate a unified medical history for comprehensive accompaniment.
Optimize our services and personalize your user experience.
Send relevant notifications about your appointments or health (always with your consent).

security.title: Security and access
security.intro: We implement bank-level security measures to protect your information:

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.text: Of all sensitive information in transit and at rest.

access.title: Restricted Access
access.text: Only professionals linked to your case can see your data.

sharing.title: Data sharing
sharing.intro: Your data is never sold. It is only shared in strictly necessary situations:
items: With the health professionals you choose for your care.
With essential technology providers (servers, payments) under strict confidentiality agreements.
When there is an express legal obligation.

rights.title: Your rights as a user
rights.intro: You have full control over your data. At any time you can:
items: Access all information we have about you.
Request correction of erroneous data or deletion of your account.
Object to the processing of your data or limit its use.
Revoke previously granted consents.
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at: privacy@platform.com

retention.title: Retention period
retention.text: We will maintain your data while your account is active or necessary to provide the service. If you decide to leave, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized for statistical purposes, unless the law requires its retention.

payments.title: Booking and cancellation policy
payments.intro: Bookings are confirmed only after payment. We understand that unforeseen circumstances may arise:
items: Cancellation with +24h notice: You can opt for a refund (minus gateway fees) or keep the balance for future appointments.
Cancellation with -24h notice: Unfortunately, we cannot make refunds due to the professional's time reservation.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.text: For monthly or annual plans, billing is automatic. If a payment fails, you will have 7 consecutive days to regularize it before benefits are suspended.

changes.title: Policy changes
changes.text: We may update this policy to reflect improvements or legal changes. We will always notify you about important changes through the platform.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.text: By using our services, you accept these conditions. We recommend reading them carefully and consulting us with any questions. We are here to take care of you.

TermsConditionsPage.title: Terms and Conditions of Use
TermsConditionsPage.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using our services. Your use of the platform implies acceptance of these conditions.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.text: By registering and using this platform, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions. We recommend reading them carefully before accessing or using our services.

description.title: Service description
description.text1: This digital platform acts as a link between users and health professionals, promoting an integrative approach. We are not a clinic nor do we provide direct diagnostic services.
description.text2: Users can access professional profiles, book consultations, maintain a shared health history, and choose different subscription plans.

registration.title: Registration and data accuracy
registration.text: To access our services, registration is required by providing truthful, current, and complete personal information. Each user is responsible for keeping their data updated and protecting their access credentials.

usage.title: Permitted use
items: Using the platform for illegal or unauthorized purposes.
Interfering with system operation or attempting to access other users' data.
Performing activities that could damage, disable, or overload the infrastructure.
usage.alert: We reserve the right to suspend or cancel accounts that infringe these terms.

professionals.title: Role of professionals
professionals.text: Each registered professional is responsible for the services they provide and for the information published in their profile. The platform does not guarantee results nor is it responsible for the content or quality of medical consultations.

payments.title: Bookings, payments, and cancellations
payments.text: The conditions for booking consultations, making payments, and canceling appointments are detailed in the Privacy Policy. By accepting these terms, you also accept such operational policies.

modifications.title: Service modifications
modifications.text: We may update features, modify plans, prices, or terms of use. Any substantial modification will be previously informed through the platform for your knowledge.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.intro: The platform is not responsible for:
items: Technical failures, temporary interruptions, or system errors.
Decisions users make based on obtained information.
The relationship between users and professionals, which is direct and personal.

intellectual.title: Intellectual property
intellectual.text: All content, trademarks, logos, designs, and tools are exclusive property of the platform or are used under license. Copying, distributing, or modifying them without express written authorization is not permitted.

suspension.title: Account suspension and cancellation
suspension.text: We may suspend or cancel accounts that fail to comply with these terms, negatively affect other users, or generate risks for system security and operation.

law.title: Applicable legislation
law.text: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Eastern Republic of Uruguay. In case of any legal conflict, the parties shall submit to the competent courts of said country.

final.title: Total Agreement
final.text: By continuing to use the platform, you accept these Terms and Conditions in their entirety.

faqs.a1: Bodhiwell is a platform and a community that connects consultants and health professionals from an integrative, human and conscious perspective.
faqs.a2: No. Bodhiwell does not function as a clinic, but as a space that facilitates the encounter between people and professionals from different areas of health.
faqs.a3: Bodhiwell seeks to build bridges between approaches, promote exchange and bring value content, favoring a less fragmented understanding of health.
faqs.q4: What type of professionals participate in Bodhiwell?
faqs.a4: Professionals from conventional, integrative, complementary medicine and other disciplines linked to human health well-being and accompaniment can be part of it.
faqs.q5: What is Bodhiwell's view on health?
faqs.a5: Bodhiwell understands health in a broad and integrative way, recognizing that different perspectives can coexist and complement each other in favor of well-being.
faqs.q6: Do I need to register to use Bodhiwell?
faqs.a6: To access certain functions, such as booking a consultation or managing your profile, yes.
faqs.q7: Why is it important to register with real data?
faqs.a7: Because it helps build a more reliable, orderly and safe experience for all the actors that are part of the platform.
faqs.q8: Can I access without contracting a plan?
faqs.a8: Yes, depending on the available modality. Some functions may be subject to the type of active account or plan.
faqs.a9: The booking is made through the platform and is confirmed when the corresponding process is correctly completed.
faqs.a10: The booking is validated once the payment has been processed through the means accepted by the platform.
faqs.a11: It depends on the modality offered by each professional. Both options may exist within the platform.
faqs.q12: Can I be treated by more than one professional?
faqs.a12: Yes. Part of Bodhiwell's proposal is to facilitate a broader accompaniment, where different perspectives can complement each other when that adds value to each person's process.
faqs.a13: Yes. Cancellations may be made within the period defined by the platform and will be subject to the conditions in force at the time of booking.
faqs.q14: Does Bodhiwell offer plans or subscriptions?
faqs.a14: Yes. The platform contemplates different types of plans, designed to accompany different usage needs.
faqs.a15: Yes, unless otherwise indicated in the conditions of the contracted plan.
faqs.q16: What happens if there is a payment difficulty?
faqs.a16: There may be a grace period before cancellation, according to the active conditions of the subscription.
faqs.a17: Yes, subject to the operational and commercial conditions of the platform.
faqs.q18: How is my personal information protected?
faqs.a18: Personal data management is carried out under criteria of privacy, protection and responsible use, in accordance with the platform's policies.
faqs.q19: Is my information shared with professionals?
faqs.a19: Only within the framework necessary for the correct functioning of the experience and the accompaniment provided through the platform.
faqs.q20: Where can I read the terms and privacy policy?
faqs.a20: In the corresponding legal sections, available within the site.
faqs.q21: Can I be part of Bodhiwell as a professional?
faqs.a21: Yes. Bodhiwell is also thought of as a community for professionals interested in a collaborative and integrative view of health.
faqs.q22: How can I apply as a professional?
faqs.a22: Through the channels or forms enabled by the platform for that purpose.
faqs.q23: What does Bodhiwell look for in the professionals who join?
faqs.a23: A willingness to accompany from professionalism, respect, openness to exchange and a broad vision of well-being.
faqs.q24: Does Bodhiwell promote work between different disciplines?
faqs.a24: Yes. The platform was born exactly from the need to generate more dialogue, synergy and collaboration between approaches that often function separately.
